text: Nerida, July 18 — Brandt-Ueno Civil won the contract to rebuild the Okarra Bridge after a closed procurement process that ended late Thursday, people familiar with the matter said. The firm beat two rivals and will begin site preparation next month under a 14.6 billion lirin agreement, they said. The rebuilt span over the Lassek River is expected to restore freight access between eastern Nerida and the inland grain belt by early 2028. Officials at the Transport Authority declined to comment on the award, but a person close to the file said Brandt-Ueno’s bid ranked highest on cost and seismic design. The original bridge was closed in March after engineers found severe cracking in two support piers.
